title: Frontier AI Safety and Alignment Research Scientist, DeepMind
location: Mountain View, CA, USA ; New York, NY, USA
desc: As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits Learn more about benefits at Google . Lead foundational and empirical research in AI safety and alignment, from mathematical formulation and algorithmic design through validation on frontier architectures. Characterize failure modes in frontier models, including newly uncovered ones, using interpretability research (mechanistic, latent-space, or black-box), and turn those findings into safeguards, mitigations, and alignment improvements. Propose novel research directions and develop scalable alignment and control interventions, including reinforcement learning methods, that anticipate vulnerabilities as AI systems become increasingly complex. Share research outcomes with internal teams across DeepMind and publish them at premier peer-reviewed AI conferences and venues. Collaborate with frontier modeling, safety, security, and product teams across DeepMind to turn scientific breakthroughs into deployed safeguards. Minimum qualifications: Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, a related quantitative technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 3 years of experience in large language models (LLM) or diffusion models: including interpretability, reinforcement learning (RL), pre-training, or representation engineering, or architectural design. Published paper(s) in machine learning or theoretical computer science conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, AISTATS, COLT, ALT, STOC, FOCS, SODA Deep learning experience evidenced by scientific papers or GitHub repositories (e.g., neural network architectures, representation space discoveries, quantization, or sparsity). Industry experience working with AI-assisted coding and AI tools. Preferred qualifications: 2 years of experience in AI safety, responsibility, security, or red-teaming. 1 year of experience developing multi-agent frameworks or autonomous agent systems. 1 year of experience researching alignment or mitigation in the latent space (e.g., mechanistic interpretability, activation steering, latent monitoring). Experience training, post-training, or evaluating large-scale foundation models using JAX, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. Experience leading multi-researcher projects from mathematical formulation to empirical validation across research and product teams.
